dedupe_keys.name: top floor vibration of a 37 storey building in bangkok during the mw 7 7 earthquake of 28 march 2025

description: This dataset gives floor acceleration responses recorded at the top floor of a 37-storey reinforced concrete building in Bangkok during the magnitude 7.7 earthquake of 28 March 2025. It was published on Zenodo on 2 April 2026 by Nakhorn Poovarodom and Amorntep Jirasakjamroonsri of Thammasat University. The records come from a low-cost TUSHM sensor system and are meant for structural health monitoring and modal identification, extracting natural frequencies, damping ratios and mode shapes under real seismic excitation. Coverage: one high-rise building in Bangkok, one event. Access: one 1 MB zip on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: a single sensor location and a low-cost sensor system. Simulation uses: calibrating tall-building models for distant large earthquakes and validating low-cost monitoring. Related records: the IES Academia Sinica seismic response data.
